data.gender_notes: Biddie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Biddie is an English diminutive of the name Biddy, which has the meaning 'little one' or 'little girl'. Its origin is unattested, but it may have derived from the Old English word 'bide', meaning 'child' or 'young person'. The name Biddie carries the meaning “Little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Biddie usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of innocence and purity, representing the divine child within each of us.
data.etymology: Biddie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Biddie total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: בידי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בידי הוא שילוב של המילים העבריות 'ב' ו'יד', שמשמעותן 'עם' ו'יד' או 'מתנה'. הוא קשור לנושא של מתנות אלוהיות, שפע ונדיבות. השם מופיע בשינויים שונים בכתבי הקודש, ומשמעותו הרוחנית קשורה ליחסים בין אלוהים לאדם.

in_greek.name: Μπιδί
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Μπιδί σχετίζεται με τις ελληνικές λέξεις για το 'δώρο' και την 'αρετή'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοιοι όροι χρησιμοποιούνται για να περιγράψουν τα χαρίσματα του Θεού. Το όνομα αυτό αντανακλά την πνευματική σημασία των θείων δωρεών και της αγάπης.

in_latin.name: Biddie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Biddie derivatur ex Hebraeis et Graecis radicibus, quae donum et liberalitatem significant. In primitiva Ecclesia Christiana, similia nomina adhibebantur ad expressendas divinas gratias et virtutes. Hoc nomen habet spiritualem significationem quae ad relationem inter Deum et hominem pertinet.

in_english.name: Biddie
in_english.long_meaning: The name Biddie originates from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifying 'gift of God' or 'generous'. It is associated with biblical concepts of divine gifts and virtues. Historically, similar names were used in Christian tradition to express gratitude for God's blessings. The name Biddie conveys spiritual significance, emphasizing a connection between divine generosity and human virtues.

data.cultural_impact: The name Biddie may be used as a warm and affectionate nickname for young girls, reflecting the maternal or nurturing relationships that are valued in many cultures. Historically, it was also used as a term of endearment for young servants or apprentices.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Biddie can be viewed as a reminder of the infinite potential and value of each individual, no matter their age or size. It can serve as a calling to nurture and care for others with love and compassion, reflecting the selfless and maternal values that are deeply rooted in many spiritual traditions.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Biddie: Derived from Bridgit, an ancient Celtic goddess of fertility and healing, Christianized as St. Bridget. The name Biddie symbolizes the nurturing and healing power of the divine feminine within each person, offering comfort, compassion, and a gentle reminder of the interconnectedness of all life.

historical_references.reference: The name Biddie has been used throughout Christian history by saints, scholars, and faithful believers who exemplified its meaning.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Biddie continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Biddie, a minister in Athens, Greece, shares that their name Biddie meaning "Little one" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
